title: An Explicit Construction of $\mathbb{S}^1$-Gerbes over the Stack $[G/G]$
summary: For a compact and connected Lie group $G$, we present an explicit construction of an $\mathbb{S}^1$-gerbe over the differentiable stack $[G/G]$ in the framework of $\mathbb{S}^1$-central extensions of Lie groupoids. This gives a complete proof of the construction outlined earlier by Behrend--Xu--Zhang, together with an explicit proof of the differential-form identity stated there without proof. In particular, when $G$ is compact, simple, and simply connected, the Dixmier--Douady class of the resulting gerbe is the canonical generator of ${\rm H}^3_G(G,\mathbb Z)$.
